classes.summary: DevicesMFE is a Page Object Model class for HP Smart web application's device management MFE (Micro Frontend). It follows a clear separation between verification flows (verify_*) and action flows (click_*, get_*). Notable patterns include: (1) Use of string-based locator identifiers passed to driver methods rather than explicit locator variables, (2) Flexible timeout and exception handling parameters for verification methods, (3) JavaScript executor usage for clicking non-displayed elements, (4) Keyboard shortcut implementation for page refresh (CTRL+R), (5) Multi-screen onboarding flow support for What's New popup with navigation controls, (6) Alpha/workaround code for Windows dummy printer testing when actual printer addition is not possible, (7) Authentication state verification through element invisibility checks. The class manages device cards, tiles, status panels, and user profile interactions within the HP Smart ecosystem.
